text:
anna (partnerships): Heads-up — partners asked for a clear SDK versioning matrix and deprecation windows before Marketplace listing goes live next month. Can we align on policy + owner?

michael (eng): timeline?

anna (partnerships): target Marketplace submission: 2025-06-15. Need partner-facing matrix + migration notes by 2025-05-20.

sanjay (platform): We have two breaking runtime changes: token-serializer rename (minor API tweak) and kv-cache layout change (incompatible). Recommend semver: runtime major bump for kv-cache, minor for serializer with compatibility shim.

julia (product): For partner Marketplace cards we need a compatibility-grade tag: 'pinned', 'compatible-with-shims', 'incompatible'.

michael (eng): Agree. Plan: publish SDK 2.1.0 with serializer shim, SDK 3.0.0 to match runtime kv-cache. Provide backports for Dedicated customers.

anna (partnerships): Partner ask: hardware partners + SI integrations need runtime image pinning guidance. Also want 90-day deprecation notice and a migration CLI.

kevin (solutions): I'll draft a partner-runbook with step-by-step migration + rollback examples. Need list of affected endpoints.

michael (eng): Affected endpoints: /generate, /chat/stream (kv-cache only when streaming + long context). I'll add endpoint flags to changelog.

sanjay (platform): Also need to check Marketplace billing: dedicated images might require new SKU mapping. pinging finance later.

release-bot: Release window for SDK 2.1.0 -> 2025-05-10; SDK 3.0.0 -> 2025-06-01. Canaries open 2025-05-12.

julia (product): Communication plan: partner webinar week of 2025-05-22, email + changelog + migration video.

anna (partnerships): Action items: michael implement shim + backports, kevin draft runbook, julia produce comms + webinar deck, sanjay validate marketplace SKUs. I'll package partner announcement draft by 2025-05-15.

michael (eng): I'll create a short migration example in repo: code snippet

```bash
# sample: pin runtime
redwoodctl deploy --image redwood/runtime:3.0.0 --pin
```

kevin (solutions): For SIs we'll include a checklist: test suite pass, DB flush guidance, canary plan.

sanjay (platform): Note: for on-prem customers we need an offline migration tarball and MD5 checksums.

julia (product): Do we want a 'compatibility-matrix.csv' in the repo? Partners asked for machine-readable.

anna (partnerships): yes — machine-readable required. michael can you populate columns: sdk_version, runtime_version, shim_required, compatibility_grade, deprecation_date.

michael (eng): yep, will open PR by EOD tomorrow.

anna (partnerships): Thanks — if no objections I'll set a partners sync call 2025-05-06 10am PT. :calendar:

julia (product): Works for me. :thumbsup:

kevin (solutions): works.

sanjay (platform): will be there.

release-bot: Thread archived: reminders set for 2025-05-10 (SDK 2.1.0) and 2025-06-01 (SDK 3.0.0).
